description_en: Modifies the employment status of a specified employee
description_zh: 通过调用本接口可修改指定员工的在职状态
kebab_example: aliyun btripopen update-employee-leave-status --user-id user_1234 --is-leave true --x-acs-btrip-corp-token feth0000wls --api-version 2022-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateEmployeeLeaveStatus

parameters.description_en: Specifies whether the employee has left the company.
parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the employee has left the company
parameters.name: is_leave

parameters.description_en:
The enterprise access token.
- When calling the operation over HTTP, include this as a **required parameter** in the request URL. For information about how to obtain it, refer to [Enterprise access token](https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=3769985).
- When appending the parameter, use any of the following formats: `so_corp_token=value`, `dtb_corp_token=value`, or `corp_token=value`. **Recommended**: `corp_token=value`.
parameters.description_zh:
企业访问凭证。
- 使用 HTTP 方式调用接口时需要**作为必填参数**拼接在请求地址中。获取方式请参见：[企业访问凭证](https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=3769985)。
- 在拼接时，可以选择 `so_corp_token=value`、`dtb_corp_token=value` 以及 `corp_token=value` 任一写法，**推荐使用** `corp_token=value`。
